situation: Old mates from uni in a group chat.
topic: Boasting and joking about how much they drink most weeks, mocking the one who wants to cut down, and daring each other to a bigger night.

text: [photo: four pints and a whiskey on a sticky pub table, one empty glass tipped over]
Thursday 🍺 seven of these before the shots lol
Seven? You were on the floor by 11 weren't you
I was on the floor by 11 on purpose
Ye I was there. Niall carried the chairs off the table himself
That was a service to the pub
I'm cutting back. Weeknights off, full stop. I've a 6am monday with a client who needs me alive
Oh here we go
Saoirse wants to be a sober girl now
I want to wake up on a tuesday without wanting to die. Not the same thing as sober
She's right tho. I felt awful all week after thursday
Sinéad you ordered the tequila
And I'd order it again
Was it the tequila or the 4 pints of cider before it
The cider was a mistake I'll admit that
Next thursday. Bigger. 10 pints each and whoever pukes buys breakfast
In for the breakfast bit
Absolutely not
Ya coward
I'm a coward with a job and a liver
Pádraig you've work monday 7am no?
It's a sparky job, I'm not climbing a ladder hungover. I'll be grand
Or I'll be fired. One of the two
10 pints is the dare, pádraig's on the fence, saoirse is a coward, sinéad is gonna be sick by 9 so she's in
I'm not agreeing to be sick by 9
You're agreeing to the tequila
Going for a walk along the prom with the dog. Don't text me the bar menu
No promises
[photo: pint of Guinness on a bar, Quay Street window in the background]
One pint. Just the one. I'm the good one tonight
You're the one who stays till close every time
Not tonight. I'm on the early start
Heading home. Not drinking tonight, sunday hike with my sister. Boring but alive
Boring
I'll be boring and alive
Home. The bed is calling. Some of us have a model to finish for monday
Bed for the architect at midnight 😴
Dare still stands. Next thursday. 10 pints
I'm not doing 10 pints niall
[photo: muddy dog standing in a bog puddle, looking pleased with himself]
Diamond Hill. Sister says we're doing the full loop. I say we're doing the bit to the lake
Is that the dog or the lake
Both are soaked
Is that Connemara behind him
Yeah it's gorgeous. Cold but gorgeous
Ye lovely day for it. Dry-ish
[photo: view from the top, grey lake and hills, sister's arm in the corner]
Sister wants this one for her feed. I said no
Saoirse wants to be a hill walker now
Shut up Niall. I've been a hill walker since I was 9
Ok hill walker
Model's nearly done. Just the roof left
Is the roof the hard bit
The roof is always the hard bit
Just got a call from a client. On a Sunday. Wants a "quick chat" about a grievance meeting tomorrow at 9
Quick chat is not a thing
Tell them put it in writing
That's what I said. I said I'll look at the file first thing and that's it
Sounds like a Monday already
It's been a Monday since 4pm
Pádraig you're still on the fence on the 10 pints or what
I'm on the fence about the fence
[photo: balsa model of a house with a slightly crooked roof]
Done. Crooked but done
Looks like a house a child would draw
Rude. It's 1:50 scale
Dog has eaten something out of the boot. Not telling you what
Good man
Got a fella in at 8 tomorrow with a shoulder that won't stop complaining. Wish me luck
Good luck. Tell him to stop reaching for the top shelf
Right. Bed. Hill walking is murder on the calves
Dare's still on. Next thursday. 10 pints
Sleeping. Goodnight Niall
Nobody here has any stamina
Up. Van's cold. Sparky life
In the car outside. Five mins and in
Shoulder man cancelled. Gift of a free hour
Done. Can't say much but it's done. Gonna be a long day
Is that a good done or a done done
Tired done. Going to the kitchen to find something sugary
Only just seeing this. Hope it went ok
Lunch. Ham sandwich, a sad apple
Niall did you get the shoulder sorted or did he come back with a new complaint
Gave him the exercises, he says they're boring. Told him that's the point
Pádraig I need a yes or no on thursday by wednesday. Fence isn't a category
It's a category
Pádraig don't let him talk you into it. You're up a ladder tomorrow
Client has sent the grievance in writing. Forty pages. I said I'd look at it, I didn't say I'd read it tonight
Forty pages. Nobody needs forty pages
Hence the dog walk at 6 and no phone
[photo: a fuse box with wires all over, one labelled in biro "DO NOT TOUCH - PAT"]
Not mine. Found it on a job. Pat is a legend
Pat is a fire hazard
Right, dinner, then drawings for the Ballybrit job. Nobody text me before 9
Nobody text her before 9
Read the first 12 pages. The word "unfair" appears a lot
Is "unfair" the complaint or the whole personality of the person making it
Niall I can't say anything about it. Going to make tea
Right. Niall. Six pints. Not ten. Six
Six is a nap
Six is what I'm offering
Fine. Six, whoever pukes buys breakfast, and Sinéad's not allowed tequila
Asleep in theory but I can see this
No tequila, agreed
Tea done. Dog asleep on the good cushin. Heading to bed, early start, telling no one about the forty pages
Nobody said bed. Physio bed at 10, tomorrow I'm holding a shoulder for 45 mins
Thursday's on. Sort it Niall
